name: shoot.add_crew
description: Adds a person to a shoot's crew under the client's id, last in the list. The same person again changes nothing; an id held by any other crew member, in any brand, is refused (the database's key).
sql:
with added as (
  insert into brandbase.crew (id, shoot_id, brand_id, name, role, position)
  select :crewId, :id, :brand, btrim(:name), btrim(:role), coalesce((select max(position) + 1 from brandbase.crew where shoot_id = :id), 0)
  where not exists (select 1 from brandbase.crew where id = :crewId and shoot_id = :id)
  returning *
)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(s), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(z.c) from (
  select to_jsonb(c) as c from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = s.id
  union all select to_jsonb(a) from added a) z), '[]')) as result
from brandbase.shoots s where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
